name: proto-oneof-protobuf-es
description: A protobuf-es v2 oneof member is read where hand code tells it apart from its siblings: an access of value on the union narrowed by a comparison of case with the member's literal reads that member, and so do the clauses of a switch that falls through two case labels; a member only create's init literal names is written and stays unreferenced; and a read of the discriminant compared with no literal reads every member of its oneof.
